display.name: Market Making Desk
display.description:
Continuous two-sided liquidity provision across the deepest perp markets. Revenue is maker rebates and captured spread; inventory is actively mean-reverted toward flat rather than held as a directional view.

Quotes are inventory-skewed. When the desk is long, offers are shifted closer to index and bids are pushed further away, so the side that reduces inventory is the side more likely to fill - the book walks itself back to flat instead of accumulating. Skew scales with how far inventory sits from the position limit, so a flat book quotes symmetrically and a near-limit book quotes hard on one side only.

Exit threshold 1.10x is intentionally close to par: a market-making book is marked continuously and should not drift far from owed value, so a small deviation is a genuine signal. The short 6-hour queue-age threshold reflects the same philosophy.
